entities.name: GENERATEQUESTIONS
entities.description: A procedure to generate high-level questions for a dataset based on corpus description, user personas, and tasks.

entities.name: LLM
entities.description: A Large Language Model used to prompt for user descriptions, task identification, and question generation.

entities.name: global sensemaking
entities.description: The target of questions requiring understanding of the entire corpus without specific low-level facts.
entities.evidence: requiring global understanding of the corpus

entities.name: head-to-head comparison approach
entities.description: An evaluation strategy using an LLM evaluator to judge relative performance.
entities.evidence: adopt the head-to-head comparison approach using an LLM evaluator

entities.name: Comprehensiveness
entities.description: A target criterion measuring how much detail an answer provides to cover all aspects of a question.
entities.evidence: How much detail does the answer provide to cover all aspects and details of the question?

entities.name: Diversity
entities.description: A target criterion measuring the variety and richness of perspectives and insights in an answer.
entities.evidence: How varied and rich is the answer in providing different perspectives and insights on the question?

entities.name: Empowerment
entities.description: A target criterion measuring how well an answer helps the reader understand and make informed judgments.
entities.evidence: How well does the answer help the reader understand and make informed judgments about the topic?

entities.name: Podcast transcripts
entities.description: A dataset example featuring a tech journalist user and questions about tech policy and regulation.

entities.name: News articles
entities.description: A dataset example featuring an educator user and questions about health and wellness.
